attempt: Call CommonAssetModule.sendAssetsToPlayer for newly generated fog model assets while the client is already Playing.
reason_failed: Hytale 0.7.0 sendAssetsToPlayer injects WorldLoadProgress before every asset part; the client accepts that packet only during SettingUp and disconnects after entering the world.
environment: Hytale 0.7.0 release, Atmosphere Tool 1.3.1, enabled 30x4x92 miasma area in The Village - Zytale 306 Working Copy
error_signature: Exception when handling packet 21 WorldLoadProgress: Received WorldLoadProgress at Playing connection stage but expected it only during SettingUp.
conditions: The world contains an enabled fog volume near the player spawn
FogVolumeRenderer creates model, animation and texture common assets after player join
The first runtime asset transfer invokes sendAssetsToPlayer on the playing packet handler
AdaptiveWindow 0.4.3 removes its own item warnings but does not prevent the disconnect
workaround: Use Atmosphere Tool 1.3.2 runtime asset sender without WorldLoadProgress; client rejoin test pending.

source_refs.description: Client enters Playing, joins world, then rejects WorldLoadProgress
Second 1.3.1 run repeats the same disconnect
1.3.1 runtime sender call identified and replaced
